title: Intake & Prioritization Playbook for Hosted API Feature Requests (chat/streaming/tools/structured-output)
creator: Arielle Mendoza
description: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization playbook for Hosted API feature requests focused on chat, streaming, tool/function calling, and structured outputs. Goal: reduce time-to-decision for enterprise requests, ensure repeatable evaluation for security/compliance, estimate engineering effort reliably, and create clear escalation and SLAs for business stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: A documented intake form (Confluence + short customer-facing questionnaire) that captures use-case, data classification, traffic profile, latency tolerances, and required guarantees.
A decision rubric with weighted factors (security/regulatory, revenue impact, engineering complexity, ROI) and example scored requests.
An escalation checklist for enterprise requests that trigger Private/Dedicated considerations and KMS/HSM requirements.
A templated PM -> ENG -> Design request summary for scoping that includes acceptance tests and monitoring requirements.
Dashboards in Console to surface outstanding triage items and SLA-for-decision metrics (target: 7 business days for P1).
proposed_workflow: 1) Intake: customer-facing intake form + AE/CS forwarded ticket with canned fields (use-case, legal constraints, scale, test datasets).
2) Triage within 48 hours: PM reviews and assigns preliminary severity (P0/P1/P2) using a checklist; if incompleted fields -> auto follow-up email template to AE/CS.
3) Technical skim: Runtime/Infra engineers provide a 3-point feasibility estimate (low/medium/high) and flag security/compliance blockers within 5 business days.
4) Prioritization: apply decision rubric in the next weekly PM prioritization sync; P1 requests require Exec sponsor or top-line ARR alignment.
5) Scope & Ticketization: create scoped PM ticket with acceptance criteria, design mocks if needed, and an engineering FRD. Add to release planning with target release window.
6) Communication: send customer a templated timeline and next steps; escalate immediately for blocked items tied to regulatory or data residency.
7) Post-release: add request to a backlog of 'triage learnings' and update rubric based on outcomes (latency/cost/quality delta).
success_metrics: Median time from intake to prioritization decision <= 7 business days for P1, <= 14 business days for P2.
% of enterprise requests with complete intake data at first submission >= 70%.
% of prioritized P1 requests that hit scoped acceptance criteria in the planned release >= 80%.
Reduction in ad-hoc Slack/email escalation cases by 60% within quarter.
Customer satisfaction (CSAT) for enterprise triage interactions >= 4.2/5.
